notes: All three findings are VERIFIED by reading the authoritative state files (WF1-STATE.json, CHECKPOINT.md), the on-disk dimension-file inventory, and git history — no inference. The WF-1 prompt's premise is contradicted by every artifact the WF-0/WF-1 agents themselves committed at the frozen review SHA 86b8f60. Severity S1 (process-integrity / decision-driving false claim) rather than S0 because no data is corrupted — the corpus is honest about being partial; the risk is purely that a downstream synthesizer believes a false completeness claim and (a) reports inflated confidence and (b) silently drops 6 entire finding classes (injection surfaces, per-prompt/startup cost, lean dead-weight, rules/docs/skills drift, telemetry interpretation, three trace journeys). RECOMMENDATION for WF-3 owner: treat the review as 15/29 PARTIAL + single-reader-unverified; re-run the 14 failed dimensions + critics + gap-fill + WF-2 per WF1-STATE.resume before any final report or sign-off. No new root causes outside the gap were discovered (read-only investigation scoped to GAP2). I did not duplicate any of the 15 completed dimensions' findings.
